# Amazon Ads MCP Starter Kit

> Amazon Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display

This repository provides pre-configured MCP (Model Context Protocol) configuration files 
for managing Amazon Ads with AI agents in Amp, Cursor, VS Code, and Claude Desktop.

The MCP server is hosted at https://mcp.synterai.com (remote HTTP, OAuth sign-in) — no installation required.

## Quick Start
1. Open this repo in your AI editor (ships .mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json), or add https://mcp.synterai.com to your MCP client
2. Sign in to Synter in the browser when prompted (OAuth). New here? https://synterai.com/sign-up
3. Start chatting with your agent
Headless/CI fallback: send X-Synter-Key with an API key from https://synterai.com/developer

## Documentation
- https://synterai.com/manual
- https://github.com/Synter-Media-AI/mcp-server

## Available Tools
Tools for campaign management, analytics, creative generation, audience sync, and conversion tracking across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, X, Microsoft, Amazon, Spotify, and The Trade Desk.
